note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as PlayStation publishes it (Exophase and PSNProfiles agree on all 55). Guides are written in our own words for this entry from the official descriptions plus the launch-era guides cited beside each trophy. GTA VI released 19 November 2026, so a few exact triggers are still unconfirmed by the cited guides and are flagged as such rather than invented.

trophies.guide: The last trophy you will earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are done, so there is nothing extra to do for this one. PowerPyx puts the whole run at about 200 hours on a 4/10 difficulty, with A Long Road (100% completion) usually the final trophy before this one. Work the roadmap in order and this unlocks itself.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first main mission of Chapter 1, right after the prologue. It is automatic story progress: play the mission through to its end and the trophy pops. PowerPyx lists it as unmissable story progress.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1: finish every main mission in the opening chapter. Nothing optional is needed for it — keep playing the story and it unlocks at the chapter's end. PowerPyx notes the story runs five chapters and takes around 60-80 hours in total.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2: finish the chapter's main missions in order and it pops at the end, like the other chapter trophies. The Of Zen list and PowerPyx both agree the chapter trophies are the easiest part of the list — pure story progress, nothing to hunt.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3: finish the chapter's main missions and the trophy unlocks at the chapter's end. It is automatic — no side content, collectible or challenge feeds into it.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4: finish the chapter's main missions and it pops at the end. By this point you are one chapter from the story's close — the gold for the final mission follows in Chapter 5.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission — the last main mission of Chapter 5, and one of the two gold trophies. It cannot be missed: finish the story and it is yours. PowerPyx lists it as the campaign's closing trophy; the other gold, A Long Road, is the 100% completion one, and it usually comes later.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the mission flow. It is a hidden story trophy, so it stays secret on PSN until it pops — just keep playing the campaign. PowerPyx confirms the mission trophies are automatic story progress and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. GTA Zone places this heist mission in Chapter 3 and notes it cannot be missed. Play the campaign in order and the trophy pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. Like every mission trophy, it is automatic: the mission appears in the campaign flow, you complete it, and the trophy unlocks. There is no optional objective tied to it.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. It is a hidden story trophy — it stays secret until earned — and it pops automatically when the mission is complete. Keep following the campaign's mission order.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown, set at Vice City International Airport. It is automatic story progress — complete the mission and the trophy pops. The airport also matters later for the Catch Me If You Can trophy.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Another automatic mission trophy: it unlocks when the mission ends, with no extra objective. If you are following the campaign in order, you cannot pass it by.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion — the in-game checklist, not literally everything in the game. PowerPyx says the checklist is roughly 60% of true completion and needs finishing after the story, including about 70 of the 80 challenges. Both PowerPyx and GTABase rank this the hardest trophy in the set. Save it for last: most of it completes itself while you chase the other trophies, and the Platinum pops right after it.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — land stunt jumps and unique stunts across Leonida. The count is cumulative across the whole run and is tracked in the Progress menu, so fold it into normal driving rather than grinding it in one session: take jumps, ramps and airtime whenever you travel. PowerPyx lists it among the silver grind trophies in the mid-game cleanup step.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — play one round of every activity type on the map (the trophy data counts 9 types). Activities include races, fishing, bowling, arcade games, the shooting range, drone races and more. The trophy pops once you have sampled each type, so it is a good early excuse to try everything once.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges — gold all 42 challenges (PowerPyx confirms the count of 42). Each range challenge has bronze, silver and gold score bands; replay a challenge until the gold score shows. This is one of the two medal grinds in the game — the other is 13 race challenges, per PowerPyx — and there are no mission gold medals to worry about.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — win one drone race at each of the 14 Top Fun venues. Learn each course's line with a practice run first, then race for the win; you need a win at every location, not 14 wins at one. The venues are spread across Leonida, so this pairs well with the exploration stage.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — win 20 distinct races, not the same race 20 times. Races are found around Leonida; each new race you win ticks the count. PowerPyx puts races in the mid-game cleanup step, after the story, when the whole map is open.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge — find Cal and out-fish him in his head-to-head challenge. Fishing is one of the map activities; the challenge is a score contest against Cal, so a better catch total wins it. PowerPyx lists fishing among the activities to try in the first story step.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — finish any arcade cabinet game. Arcades are found in Vice City; pick the shortest game on the cabinet and play it through to its end. It also counts toward trying every activity type for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy — finish Andy's mission strand to its last mission. Side-character strands unlock as the story progresses; play Andy's missions whenever they appear on the map. The Of Zen roadmap puts the five side-character finales in step 2, after the campaign.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton — finish Kenton's mission strand to its last mission. Like Andy's, it is a side-character finale: the strand's missions appear as the story advances, and the trophy pops at the final one. Do the strand's missions when they show up rather than leaving them all for the end.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy — finish Billy's mission strand to its last mission. The strand unlocks through story progress; keep an eye on the map for Billy's missions and play them as they appear so the finale is waiting for you after the campaign.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida — finish eight full stranger mission strands. Stranger missions appear as icons on the map as you explore, and each strand runs several missions long. PowerPyx puts this in step 3, after the story; optional missions can disappear after a while (black icons with pink letters, per PowerPyx), but that does not block trophies — still, start a strand when it appears rather than ignoring it for hours.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy — finish Randy's mission strand to its last mission. Side-character finales unlock through the story; play Randy's missions as they appear and the finale pops when the strand ends.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone — finish Tyrone's mission strand to its last mission. The fifth of the side-character finales; like the others, it only needs the strand played through to its end, with the missions appearing as the story advances.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 meditation spots at 10 locations (PowerPyx). POSSIBLY MISSABLE: the first meditation, Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning and accept when she offers to meditate — disappears after Chapter 1, and it is unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it in Chapter 1 to be safe. You can meditate with Lucia and Jason at each spot (two meditations per location); track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. The final meditation needs both characters playable together, which only opens up after the story lets you play them together.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — complete Bret's unique animal hunt. Bret's strand is one of the side-character missions; the hunt target is a specific animal, so follow Bret's instructions to its location. PowerPyx's step 1 advises scanning vehicles and animals as you play, since the animal variety is spread across the whole map.
trophies.name: Fair Game

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets — collect and complete three full card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; each set needs every card in it, so this is a long hunt across the map. Track sets under Progress > Collections, and collect cards whenever you pass an area you have not searched yet.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations — use the WAiNK app at 100 different spots. Open the WAiNK app at each new location you visit; the count is per location, so keep using it while exploring rather than spamming it in one place. This pairs naturally with the explore-all-of-Leonida stage.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges — clear 50 of the map's challenges. PowerPyx counts 80 challenges in total, with about 70 needed for the 100% checklist, so 50 sits well inside the checklist work. Challenges are scattered activities across Leonida; the Progress menu shows your count, and most of them complete while you work the other trophies.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat — reach 4 stars with your partner beside you, then lose the cops together. Build heat with your partner in the car, then break line of sight and hide until the stars clear. Doing it with your partner present is the whole requirement, so do not go solo.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level — chain three shop robberies without the wanted level dropping. Plan a route past three shops, rob each quickly with your partner, and keep the heat alive between them: if the stars clear, the chain resets and you start over.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — get in or scan 100 different vehicles. Every new vehicle model you drive or scan counts, and the variety is spread across the whole map, so PowerPyx's step 1 advice applies: scan vehicles as you play instead of leaving it all for cleanup. Check the count in the Progress menu.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus — line up five kills inside one Combat Focus window. Trigger Combat Focus with a group of enemies close together and keep firing until five are down before it ends. A busy shootout with clustered enemies is the easiest setup.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — trigger the unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport. Head to the airport and leave by an unscheduled route; the Of Zen list describes it as a one-off stunt you can trigger at any time, so it fits the post-story cleanup. The exact trigger is still being pinned down by launch guides, so try the airport's runways and exits.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — the description is a joke line, and the exact trigger is not yet pinned down by the cited guides: it ties to the Rhino tanks, most likely a wanted-level encounter with them. The Of Zen list calls it a one-off stunt you can trigger at any time. Do not guess at it — check the cited guides again once more players have confirmed the trigger.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — clear a jewelry store with no alarms raised and no witnesses. Go in quiet, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, take the goods and leave before anyone calls it in. If you are spotted, leave and try again — detection voids the attempt.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape — crack five bank vaults and get away each time. Bank vault robberies are repeatable heist-style jobs; escape the pursuit after each one and the count rises. Plan the getaway before you crack the vault, since the escape is half the requirement.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape — hit an armored truck and lose the pursuit. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida; ambush one, take the cash, and break away from the cops. One clean hit and escape is all it takes.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — reveal every region of the map (the trophy data counts 52 areas). Drive, fly or sail into each area until the map is fully revealed. This happens naturally if you travel everywhere for the other trophies, so check the map for dark corners during cleanup.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang — hit one illegal operation for every gang (the trophy data counts 9 gangs). Illegal operations are marked on the map once discovered; work through the gang list one by one and the trophy pops after the last gang's operation is robbed.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — order a cocktail at the Ocean Beach spot. Head to the bar on Ocean Beach and order the cocktail; PowerPyx lists this one as not yet known, so the exact venue may need confirming once more players reach it. It is a small one-off moment, not a grind.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car through a showroom window. Pick a vehicle showroom, get a car moving through the glass, and get out. PowerPyx marks it not yet known; the Of Zen list describes it as a one-off stunt, so treat the exact showroom as unconfirmed until the guides agree.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — bowl a game at the Kolt & Associates alley. Find the alley, start a game and play it through to the end. It is one of the activity trophies, and it also counts as trying an activity type for Master of None.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — a story trophy that unlocks during the campaign. PowerPyx lists it among the five vague story trophies whose exact moment is not yet pinned down; keep playing the story and it pops on its own. There is nothing to hunt for it.
trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse) — a story trophy tied to a choice in the campaign. The trophy data tracks a count toward 500, which suggests repeated choices feed it, so keep making story choices as they come. PowerPyx lists it as not yet known; it unlocks through campaign play, not a separate hunt.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — a story trophy that unlocks during the campaign, most likely on a second attempt at something. PowerPyx lists it as not yet known; play the story and it comes on its own. Do not force it — the trigger is a story moment, not a grind.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? — a story trophy tied to a strange moment in the campaign. PowerPyx lists it as not yet known; it unlocks through story play, so keep playing and it pops when the moment arrives. The vague description is deliberate — it hides a story beat.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — take out a target with a melee drive-by, a drive-by attack using a melee weapon from a vehicle. PowerPyx lists it as not yet known; try a melee drive-by from a slow-moving vehicle once the story gives you the chance. The name is a bowling pun — it is not about the bowling alley.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts — launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; pass them to your contacts to clean them, and the total is cumulative across the whole run. Robberies done for the other trophies feed this one.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — spend $100,000 across the shops in the game. Normal shopping counts and it accumulates across the whole run, so it usually pops while you buy gear, clothes and ammo. If it is the last one left, spend the surplus on the most expensive shop goods.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — buy every garage property on the map (the trophy data counts 8 garages). Garages are bought through the in-game property listings; each one needs the cash up front, so save this for the money stage when laundering and robberies have filled your wallet.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — register ten vehicles through the Scooter Bros app. Open the app, register vehicles you own or find, and repeat until ten are on the books. Any ten vehicles count, so use the ones you already drive.
trophies.name: On the Spot

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 Trophy List
